notes.sowing: Sow {cm:1.3} deep 1 to 4 weeks before your last frost. For the fall crop, which is often the better one, sow 10 to 12 weeks before your first fall frost.
notes.care: Thin early types to {cm:10} to {cm:15} apart. Water steadily, since dry spells make turnips bolt and turn bitter. Light frosts improve the flavor.
notes.harvest: Pull early turnips between golf-ball and tennis-ball size, about 6 to 10 weeks after sowing; bigger roots turn woody. Young tops can be picked as greens, a few leaves per plant.
